title: ChipBlocks PDK manifest
description: Single source of truth for process nodes + cell libraries. Per ADR-005, this file is authored at repo root. Shuttles reference rows here via the `pdk` field. Blocks are technology-independent until elaboration, so adding a new PDK doesn't change the block library — it changes which cell library the build flow targets.

id.description: PDK id referenced by shuttles.yaml.pdk. PDK names are vendor-canonical (e.g. 'sky130A' not 'sky130-a' — matches SkyWater's convention).

feature_size_nm.description: Process feature size in nanometers (130 for sky130, 180 for gf180, etc.).

cell_library.description: Standard-cell library name (e.g. 'sky130_fd_sc_hd' for SkyWater 130 high-density).

cell_library_path.description: Filesystem-style path to the cell library Verilog files, with $(PDK_ROOT) style placeholders.

pdk_root_env.description: Environment variable name that points to the PDK installation root (e.g. 'PDK_ROOT').

default_pnr_tool.description: Default place-and-route tool for this PDK (e.g. 'openlane' for sky130).

default_density_target.description: Default PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT for OpenLane/LibreLane, expressed as a fraction 0..1.

open_source_license.description: License of the PDK itself (e.g. 'Apache-2.0' for sky130, 'Apache-2.0' for gf180).

analog_capable.description: True if the PDK ships transistor models suitable for analog design (e.g. BJTs for RF frontends).
